svg.aria-label: Arithmetic check: 31,578 divided by 5,480 equals 5.76, rounded to 5.8; 351 divided by 15 equals 23.4 per day; 312 minus 262 divided by 262 equals 19.08 percent; 47,680 minus 2,331 divided by 47,680 equals 95.11 percent padding
svg.title: Check the maths: four calculations from published figures
svg.text: Check the maths yourself — four calculations, no new figures
Every input is a published figure from the claim register BD-INV-001 or its CSV.
Rounding is shown, not hidden: 5.76 becomes 5.8, 23.4 becomes 23, 19.08% becomes 19%.
Two gaps are NOT calculations and cannot be checked this way: 2,331 vs 2,332, and the
Eid-ul-Fitr 2026 figure, reported not re-computed. Both are flagged, not smoothed.
